title: Research audit: linear subset-budget bound for commuting dirty intervals
body:
PR1244 leaves open whether commuting factors admit interval amplification linear in the subset norm budget. This research audit supplies an all-size induction for the unchanged PR628 balanced dirty word, including its shared deeper scratch.

For every n >= 1, every pair of complete-leaf cuts, and both signs, every surviving free-algebra monomial uses each factor index at most once. Thus pairwise commuting bounded linear factors with every subset product bounded by G >= 1 satisfy

`||P_t P_s^-1|| <= C^2 G`, where `C = 2 * 3^ceil(log2 n)`.

The safe generic PR905 bound was `C^2 G^2`. The new step is a six-case decomposition: intervals spanning two occurrences of the same child become a child interval plus a rank-one term with disjoint factor supports. The proof covers both cut orders and preserves reused scratch. It retains PR905's coefficient bound; PR1085's sharper prefix count is not needed.

**Status: research audit / all-size lemma. No new kappa.** PR1244's noncommuting obstruction remains valid. The conditional error-transport inequality improves, but no new rounded implementation, working-precision formula, cost invoice, or supplier adoption is asserted. Preparation, internal leaf growth, source access, copies, restoration, recursive children, physical/compiler and analytic obligations remain separate.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/commuting-interval-audit/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_COMMUTING_INTERVAL_PACKAGE`.

- 2,154,828 exact free-algebra intervals for n=1..24 and both signs; 108 sampled two-cut cases through n=129. Repetitions remain in the polynomial representation.
- Independently constructed words match 57 executions of the pinned source dispatcher.
- Full dense rational matrices and Gauss-Jordan inversion check 144 scalar cases and nine noncommuting block cases.
- A separate model constructs no recursive word and checks 108 induction identities on constrained child matrices with shared scratch.
- Five mathematical controls, four actual package corruptions, and full read-only relocation pass on CPython 3.15.0.
- All seven vendor files match pinned Git blobs. Selected-record integrity and all 25 related tests pass.

The all-size claim rests on the written induction, not finite extrapolation. The source replay instruments `compose`; numerical leaves do not run. Independent models mean separate implementations, not independent human review. No hosted CI, full supplier cold replay, or proof-assistant multiplication theorem is claimed. VALIDATION.json records two corrected harness/invocation issues.

## Provenance and contribution

Only `research/commuting-interval-audit/` is added. Base: `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8`. OS seed 64, adversarial audit. The local claim records three candidates and bounded selection. The final refresh covers 866 open PRs, 29 discussion records and 325 local records, with complete pagination and no warnings; PR1244 explicitly identifies this open follow-up.

Credit Chafik Boukhalfa (PR628/905), Hanson Sun (PR1244 and PR1085), Gareth Davidson (PR877), and their retained lineage. Exact sources, licenses and notices remain unchanged. Prepared for Charles Bethin with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code, verification and writing. No literature-priority or external human-review claim.

Open next questions identify the rounded-contract substitution and sharper interval coefficient bound, with concrete first steps and remaining blockers. The selected frontier and `upstream/` stay unchanged.
